# Standalone TTPF exporter

The Rust source and confirmed BC1 history were imported from Leonida revision 86ca164c257f78ab5de586539d01dce214dc924f. This directory carries the upstream GPL v3 license. The Python batch tool runs the compiled executable in a separate process. The local CLI adds the selected recipe to successful manifest rows. [Upstream revision](https://github.com/wish131400/Leonida/tree/86ca164c257f78ab5de586539d01dce214dc924f) · [License](LICENSE)

The entropy modules come from bcpack-rs revision 0a887de1edc9c22a425605091f1a8365fdf74dbb, under MIT or Apache-2.0. The rANS implementation and tables also carry the Microsoft notice.
